name: sink-on-set
description: Sink on Set - digital wardrobe & costume management platform for film and TV production

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run db:setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
